obligations.note: Ticket CHG-24191 is approved by change manager Grace Kim and its components (mortgage.approvals, mortgage.reporting, mortgage.tests) cover all three files touched by the change.
Wen Li (wen.li@fernbrook.example) holds the change_approver role for baseline-mortgage and is not the author (Nneka Okafor); the code_review approval is valid.
The code_review approval names commit 9c83683d, which is the head commit, so it covers exactly what is merged.

The CI run (run.json) executed on commit b5cc1851 (the first of two commits). The second commit 9c83683d changes the behaviour of Approvals.requiredApprovals, which is not a comment-only or formatting edit, so the earlier CI run does not satisfy the requirement for testing on the final commit.

Ledger entry ACR-0405 (LIM-1, proof for Approvals.java#requiredApprovals) was produced on commit d30b2adb. This change modifies the requiredApprovals method in Approvals.java with a behavioural change, lapsing that evidence. No replacement proof or re-run is provided.

The approved policy sets the single-underwriter limit at 500,000 (UNDERWRITER_LIMIT). The new code allows a single UNDERWRITER to approve up to min(SENIOR_LIMIT, 2×UNDERWRITER_LIMIT) = 1,000,000, which exceeds the approved 500,000 ceiling. The code no longer equals the approved values.

The maker-checker guard (actor.userId().equals(loanCase.preparedBy()) → throw) in Approvals.approve() is unchanged; only the requiredApprovals threshold was modified. The preparer-still-cannot-approve rule remains intact.

summary: The change modifies Approvals.requiredApprovals so that a single underwriter may approve loans up to 1,000,000 (2 × 500,000), directly violating the approved LIM-1 limit of 500,000 for a single underwriter. Because this is a behavioural change, the CI run on the first commit does not satisfy CHG-4, and the previously accepted proof for LIM-1 (ACR-0405) lapses under LAP-1 with no replacement evidence supplied. The change must be rejected and re-submitted with a CI run on the final commit, a new LIM-1 proof or control-test pass, and an approval that covers the corrected logic.
